title: Fibrewise a.e. constancy gives the product form H(t, α) = slice average
statement: Let a, b, c, d ∈ ℝ with c < d, I := (a, b), J := (c, d), and let H : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ be Lebesgue integrable on I × J. Assume that for almost every t ∈ I there is k ∈ ℝ with H(t, α) = k for almost every α ∈ J. Then H(t, α) = (d − c)⁻¹·∫_J H(t, β) dβ for almost every (t, α) ∈ I × J.
lean_statement: ∀ (a b c d : ℝ) (H : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), c < d → IntegrableOn H (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo c d) → (∀ᵐ t, t ∈ Ioo a b → ∃ k : ℝ, ∀ᵐ α, α ∈ Ioo c d → H (t, α) = k) → ∀ᵐ p : ℝ × ℝ, p ∈ Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo c d → H p = (d - c)⁻¹ * ∫ α in Ioo c d, H (p.1, α)
